description: Mutant spec for DIR-017. Single source of truth: testdata/README.md renders its mutant table from this file, scripts/check_mutants.py verifies every anchor against the tree, and scripts/mutate.py applies each active mutant alone and runs its killers. Anchor rule: 'before' must have exactly one occurrence that begins on 'line' (1-based); other copies of the text elsewhere in the file are allowed. 'after' replaces that occurrence; an empty 'after' removes it. 'before' may span lines; a newline in 'after' splits it. 'killers' are Python test names (Class.method, run from 'suite') or Go -run selectors (Parent/subtest-regex, run in 'package').
